lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of vertically aligned high-luminance centroids arranged in roughly equidistant columns spanning from the posterior margin of the gill slits toward the caudal region. Primary clusters exhibit a 3-4 node vertical count per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance circular blobs, creating a grid-like topology where the blobs serve as primary nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from high (top) to low (bottom) across the ridge line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the posterior half and basal region of the visible first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of smaller, lower-intensity high-frequency spots across the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit.
